input.job_post: Lead Roofing Technician, Dayton OH. Full time, Monday-Friday 7am-3:30pm. You will run a 3-person crew on residential and light-commercial re-roofs. Required: valid Ohio driver's license, OSHA 10 certification, 3+ years of shingle or low-slope roofing. Preferred: crew lead experience, TPO/EPDM membrane work, estimating with EagleView reports. Nice to have: Spanish.

applications.name: Luis Alvarez
applications.resume_text: Roofer, Miami Valley Roofing, 2019-present. Lead a 4-man crew on tear-offs, 30+ homes a season. Installed TPO on 6 strip-mall jobs. OSHA 10 (2021). Ohio CDL Class B. Bilingual English/Spanish.

applications.name: Erin Brennan
applications.resume_text: Roofing laborer 2024-2026, Kettering. Shingle tear-off and install. OSHA 10 card. Looking to grow into a lead role.

applications.name: Daniel Cho
applications.resume_text: Commercial roofing foreman, 2016-2025, Columbus. EPDM and TPO, crews of 5-8. Wrote estimates from EagleView reports. Driver's license. Available any shift.

applications.resume_text: Residential roofing 2020-present, Springfield OH, shingles and gutters. Ran the crew when the owner was out. Valid Ohio license. Note: certifications on request.
